sub_sector.value: Senior housing REIT; outpatient medical REIT

financial_business_type.detail: Diversified healthcare REIT that owns and manages senior housing and outpatient medical properties.

revenue_driver.detail: Outpatient medical properties earn rental income under long-term leases. Senior housing returns depend on operating performance.

customer_type.detail: Healthcare providers lease outpatient medical space. National senior housing operators are partners, and residents are end users.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Property ownership exposes the REIT to tenant credit risk and senior housing operating performance.

notes: The relative size of the segments and the senior housing revenue mix are unclear.
